signature.name: VTask.IsSkewAdjoint
signature.type: {R : Type u_1} -> {M : Type u_5} -> {M₂ : Type u_7} -> [CommRing R] -> [AddCommGroup M] -> [Module R M] -> [AddCommGroup M₂] -> [Module R M₂] -> (B : M →ₗ[R] M →ₗ[R] M₂) -> (f : M → M) -> Prop

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: IsSkewAdjoint is a Prop-valued predicate with no junk-value conventions; it is simply true or false for any inputs, including degenerate ones such as the zero bilinear map or the zero module.
